references.title: Domestic LPG cylinder price hiked by Rs 29, new rates effective from today; 14.2-kg LPG cylinder in Delhi costs Rs…
references.snippet: The domestic LPG cylinder price in Delhi has been increased by ₹29, taking the cost from ₹913 to ₹942 per 14.2 kg cylinder. This is the second price hike in three months, following a previous increase of ₹60 in March 2026, resulting in a cumulative rise of ₹89 over this period. The hike was implemented by state-run oil marketing companies to offset losses incurred due to rising global energy costs. 1 International crude oil prices: Fluctuations in global oil markets directly impact domestic LPG costs. 2 Exchange rate: The value of the Indian Rupee against the US Dollar affects import costs. 3 Government policies and subsidies: Subsidy amounts are credited to consumers’ bank accounts, influencing the effective price. 4 Distribution and logistics costs: Transportation, bottling, and local taxes contribute to regional price variations 1 The price mentioned is for domestic use; commercial LPG cylinders (19 kg) are priced higher, e.g., ₹3,113.50 in Delhi. 2 LPG cylinders are available from major providers like Indane, Bharat Gas, and HP Gas, and can be booked online, via mobile apps, or through customer care services. 3 Despite the hike, domestic LPG remains subsidized and more affordable compared to commercial rates.Consumers in Delhi should expect the 14.2 kg cylinder to cost ₹942 for household use, and it is advisable to check with local distributors for any minor variations or delivery charges.
